title: Transfer: Volcano Waveform QC Report
goal: Inspect continuous volcano-monitoring MiniSEED traces, merge or compare overlapping segments by station-channel, quantify gaps, overlaps, sample-rate inconsistencies, and time coverage, and emit a machine-readable waveform quality-control report.
skillBenefitRationale: This task relies on reading waveform files into ObsPy Streams, examining Trace stats, handling timing metadata, and reasoning about segment continuity. The essential capability is the ObsPy waveform data API.
